component.name: vinoSearch
component.summary: Semantic file search for KDE and GNOME

description.p: Search your local files by content from KRunner and GNOME Shell. Models run locally on an Intel NPU through OpenVINO, with GPU and CPU fallback.

ul.li: Show a tray icon while indexing runs
Show what Re-index found in the settings window
Fix a stack overflow when indexing code files, and harden subprocess and HTTP handling
Redraw the tray icon to match the other vinoPilot apps
Index and open vinoWhisper sessions from its Flatpak
Show how many audio and video files are waiting for AC power
Use a two-column layout for setting groups in wide windows
Report "dev" as the version on non-release builds so vinoPilot can distinguish them
Support TPM-sealed index encryption inside Flatpak via the host TPM
Add custom client-side title bars to the settings and search windows
